name: baseline
purpose: Matching independent producer and reader DTOs, with an explicit Boot JSON chain.

name: remove-required
purpose: Remove producer tenant while the reader still requires it; restore the producer file to recheck the correction.

name: add-optional
purpose: Add producer note while the default Spring JSON reader ignores unknown properties.

name: customizer-control
purpose: A producer factory customizer makes the otherwise ordinary Boot wire chain unproven.

name: historical-reader
purpose: Current producer and reader agree, but the producer at the Git base lacks tenant required by the current reader.
